d: Martin Simmonds has been haunted throughout his life by the mysterious disappearance of his "brother" and extraordinary best friend, a Polish Jewish virtuoso  violinist, Dovidl Rapaport, who vanished shortly before his 1951 London debut concert.
Grace counts everything because numbers hold her world together, but a chance encounter with Seamus unravels her meticulously ordered life.
Josh is a lost soul with an extraordinary musical talent set on a journey to encounter what he was least expecting but undoubtedly needed most.
When her husband Samuel is mysteriously found dead in the snow below their secluded chalet, Sandra becomes the main suspect when the police begin to question whether he fell or was pushed.
